blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Express the following sums or differences as products: \(\sin 5\theta + \sin 3\theta\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Question 1 ka ulta kaam hai: wahan product ko sum banaya tha, yahan sum ko product banana hai. Product ki shakal is liye faidemand hai ke equations solve karte waqt ya fractions simplify karte waqt common factor nazar aa jata hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(\sin 5\theta + \sin 3\theta\) ko product likhna.
Plan: \(\sin P + \sin Q = 2\sin\frac{P + Q}{2}\cos\frac{P - Q}{2}\), jahan \(P = 5\theta\), \(Q = 3\theta\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin 5\theta + \sin 3\theta\).
Humein find karna hai: product.
Tareeqa: Sum formula
\[\sin P + \sin Q\]
\[= 2\sin\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: "aadha jama" aur "aadha farq" nikalo, phir dono functions mein daal do.

Aadha jama aur aadha farq nikalein
\[\dfrac{P + Q}{2} = \dfrac{8\theta}{2} = 4\theta\]
\[\dfrac{P - Q}{2} = \dfrac{2\theta}{2} = \theta\]
Kyun: Yahi do angles product ke andar jayenge. Pehle yeh alag nikal lena ghaltiyon se bachata hai.

Formula mein rakh dein
\[\sin 5\theta + \sin 3\theta\]
\[= 2\sin 4\theta\cos\theta\]
Kyun: "sin + sin" mein aadha jama sine ke saath aur aadha farq cosine ke saath jata hai.

Tasdeeq: Question 1 wale formula se wapas khol kar dekhein
\[2\sin 4\theta\cos\theta\]
\[= \sin 5\theta + \sin 3\theta \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\) mein \(4\theta + \theta = 5\theta\) aur \(4\theta - \theta = 3\theta\). Asal sum wapas mil gaya, matlab jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Express the following sums or differences as products: \(\sin 8\theta - \sin 4\theta\)
blocks.explanation:
Do sines ka farq (difference) hai.
Find kya karna hai? Isay product likhna.
Plan: \(\sin P - \sin Q = 2\cos\frac{P + Q}{2}\sin\frac{P - Q}{2}\), jahan \(P = 8\theta\), \(Q = 4\theta\). Is formula mein cosine pehle aata hai, yeh yaad rakhein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin 8\theta - \sin 4\theta\).
Humein find karna hai: product.
Tareeqa: Formula
\[\sin P - \sin Q\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\sin\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
"sin minus sin" ke liye yahi formula hai.

Naye angles nikalein
\[\dfrac{P + Q}{2} = \dfrac{12\theta}{2} = 6\theta\]
\[\dfrac{P - Q}{2} = \dfrac{4\theta}{2} = 2\theta\]
Kyun: \(8\theta + 4\theta = 12\theta\) ka aadha \(6\theta\), aur \(8\theta - 4\theta = 4\theta\) ka aadha \(2\theta\).

Formula mein rakh dein
\[\sin 8\theta - \sin 4\theta\]
\[= 2\cos 6\theta\sin 2\theta\]
Kyun: "sin − sin" mein cosine aadha jama leta hai aur sine aadha farq.
Dhyan dein: \(2\sin 6\theta\cos 2\theta\) likhna aam ghalti hai; woh to \(\sin 8\theta + \sin 4\theta\) ka jawab hai.

Tasdeeq: wapas khol kar
\[2\cos 6\theta\sin 2\theta\]
\[= \sin 8\theta - \sin 4\theta \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(2\cos\alpha\sin\beta = \sin(\alpha + \beta) - \sin(\alpha - \beta)\) se asal expression wapas aa gaya.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Express the following sums or differences as products: \(\cos 6\theta + \cos 3\theta\)
blocks.explanation:
Do cosines ka jama hai.
Find kya karna hai? Product ki shakal.
Plan: \(\cos P + \cos Q = 2\cos\frac{P + Q}{2}\cos\frac{P - Q}{2}\). Is dafa angles poore nahi bantay, fraction mein rahenge, aur yeh bilkul theek hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos 6\theta + \cos 3\theta\).
Humein find karna hai: product.
Tareeqa: Formula
\[\cos P + \cos Q\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
"cos + cos" se do cosines ka product banta hai.

Naye angles nikalein
\[\dfrac{P + Q}{2} = \dfrac{9\theta}{2}\]
\[\dfrac{P - Q}{2} = \dfrac{3\theta}{2}\]
Kyun: 9 aur 3 odd numbers hain, in ka aadha poora number nahi banta, is liye fraction hi likhenge. Students aksar sochte hain ke fraction aaya to ghalti hui, lekin aisa nahi hai.

Formula mein rakh dein
\[\cos 6\theta + \cos 3\theta\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{9\theta}{2}\cos\dfrac{3\theta}{2}\]
Kyun: Dono angles cosine ke andar jate hain kyunke yeh "cos + cos" hai.

Tasdeeq: wapas khol kar
\[2\cos\dfrac{9\theta}{2}\cos\dfrac{3\theta}{2}\]
\[= \cos 6\theta + \cos 3\theta \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\frac{9\theta}{2} + \frac{3\theta}{2} = \frac{12\theta}{2} = 6\theta\) aur \(\frac{9\theta}{2} - \frac{3\theta}{2} = \frac{6\theta}{2} = 3\theta\); "2 cos cos" formula se wohi sum mila.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Express the following sums or differences as products: \(\cos 7\theta - \cos \theta\)
blocks.explanation:
Do cosines ka farq hai. Chaaron formulas mein sirf isi ke aage minus aata hai, is liye sab se zyada ghaltiyan yahin hoti hain.
Find kya karna hai? Product ki shakal.
Plan: \(\cos P - \cos Q = -2\sin\frac{P + Q}{2}\sin\frac{P - Q}{2}\), aur minus sign aage hi rakhna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos 7\theta - \cos\theta\).
Humein find karna hai: product.
Tareeqa: Formula
\[\cos P - \cos Q\]
\[= -2\sin\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\sin\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
Is ka minus is liye aata hai ke angle barhne par (0 se 180 degree tak) cosine kam hota hai.

Naye angles nikalein
\[\dfrac{P + Q}{2} = \dfrac{8\theta}{2} = 4\theta\]
\[\dfrac{P - Q}{2} = \dfrac{6\theta}{2} = 3\theta\]
Kyun: \(P = 7\theta\), \(Q = \theta\). \(\theta\) ka matlab \(1\theta\) hai, is liye jama \(8\theta\) aur farq \(6\theta\).

Formula mein rakh dein
\[\cos 7\theta - \cos\theta\]
\[= -2\sin 4\theta\sin 3\theta\]
Kyun: Dono angles sine mein jate hain aur aage \(-2\) aata hai.
Dhyan dein: Minus chhor dena sab se aam ghalti hai. Yaad rakhein: "cos minus cos = minus 2 sin sin".

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 20^{\circ}\)
\[\cos 140^{\circ} - \cos 20^{\circ} \approx -1.7057\]
\[-2\sin 80^{\circ}\sin 60^{\circ} \approx -1.7057 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\cos 140^{\circ}\) negative hai, is liye left side negative hai; right side bhi minus ki wajah se negative aur barabar hai. Agar minus bhool jate to sign ulta aata.

blocks.prompt: 2 (v) Express the following sums or differences as products: \(\cos 12^{\circ} + \cos 48^{\circ}\)
blocks.explanation:
Fixed angles ke do cosines ka jama hai. Yahan aik khoobsurat baat hogi: aadha jama \(30^{\circ}\) banega, jis ki value hum jaante hain.
Find kya karna hai? Product ki shakal (aur chahein to simplify).
Plan: \(\cos P + \cos Q\) formula, bara angle \(P\), phir \(\cos 30^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos 12^{\circ} + \cos 48^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: product.
Tareeqa: Formula
\[\cos P + \cos Q\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
jahan \(P = 48^{\circ}\), \(Q = 12^{\circ}\).
Note: scan mein beech ka sign halka hai; answer key ke jawab \(2\cos 30^{\circ}\cos 18^{\circ}\) se pakka hai ke yeh plus hai.

Naye angles nikalein
\[\dfrac{P + Q}{2} = \dfrac{60^{\circ}}{2} = 30^{\circ}\]
\[\dfrac{P - Q}{2} = \dfrac{36^{\circ}}{2} = 18^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Jama kisi bhi order mein ho, jawab wohi hai, is liye bara angle \(P\) liya taa ke aadha farq positive aaye. Agar \(P = 12^{\circ}\) lete to \(\cos(-18^{\circ})\) aata, jo \(\cos 18^{\circ}\) hi hai kyunke cosine even function hai.

Formula mein rakh dein
\[\cos 12^{\circ} + \cos 48^{\circ}\]
\[= 2\cos 30^{\circ}\cos 18^{\circ}\]
Kyun: "cos + cos" se do cosines ka product.

Mazeed simplify (agar chahein)
\[= 2\cdot\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cos 18^{\circ}\]
\[= \sqrt{3}\cos 18^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 30^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\) aur 2 cancel ho gaye. Answer key \(2\cos 30^{\circ}\cos 18^{\circ}\) deti hai; dono sahi hain.

Tasdeeq calculator se
\[\cos 12^{\circ} + \cos 48^{\circ} \approx 1.6473\]
\[\sqrt{3}\cos 18^{\circ} \approx 1.6473 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono taraf ek hi value. Is se yeh bhi pakka hua ke beech ka sign plus hi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (vi) Express the following sums or differences as products: \(\sin(x + 30^{\circ}) + \sin(x - 30^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Do sines ka jama hai jin ke angles \(x + 30^{\circ}\) aur \(x - 30^{\circ}\) hain.
Find kya karna hai? Product ki shakal.
Plan: \(\sin P + \sin Q\) formula, angles ko brackets ke saath jama/minus karna, phir \(\cos 30^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin(x + 30^{\circ}) + \sin(x - 30^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: product.
Tareeqa: Formula
\[\sin P + \sin Q\]
\[= 2\sin\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]

Naye angles nikalein
\[\dfrac{P + Q}{2} = \dfrac{2x}{2} = x\]
\[\dfrac{P - Q}{2} = \dfrac{60^{\circ}}{2} = 30^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Jama mein \(+30^{\circ}\) aur \(-30^{\circ}\) cancel. Farq mein \((x + 30^{\circ}) - (x - 30^{\circ})\): bracket kholte waqt \(-(-30^{\circ}) = +30^{\circ}\), is liye \(60^{\circ}\) bana aur \(x\) cancel ho gaya.

Formula mein rakh dein
\[\sin(x + 30^{\circ}) + \sin(x - 30^{\circ})\]
\[= 2\sin x\cos 30^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Aadha jama sine ke saath, aadha farq cosine ke saath.

Mazeed simplify (agar chahein)
\[= 2\sin x\cdot\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[= \sqrt{3}\sin x\]
Kyun: \(\cos 30^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\). Answer key \(2\sin x\cos 30^{\circ}\) deti hai; dono shaklein sahi hain.

Tasdeeq: \(x = 30^{\circ}\)
\[\sin 60^{\circ} + \sin 0^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[\sqrt{3}\sin 30^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono sides barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.
